thread:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — APAC dry run for H200/MI300/Gaudi compatibility in our Tokyo lab. Need to confirm driver microcode and power derate windows before we lock marketplace SKUs. Propose timeline: test week May 6-10. Thoughts?

sam-ops: +1 on timeline. Do we have a spare B200 bench for fallback if H200 nodes flake?

liang-mlops: We can carve 4 H200s and 2 Gaudis. MI300 hosts currently report kernel image 1.2.3 on staging — I'll verify firmware and thermals.

anita-sales: Heads up — APAC SI partner asked about a joint announcement possibility mid-May if we sign off. That will require clear compatibility signoff and embargo coordination (legal + PR).

tom-hw-eng: Driver note: Nvidia released H200 microcode v2.4 fixing some thermal throttling, but it introduces an nvlink negotiation change that can break B200 fallback paths. Recommend test matrix: H200 v2.4 vs v2.3, and B200 nvlink sanity checks.

labbot: lab-scheduler: Reserved resources: tokyo-1: h200x4, gaudix2, mi300x2 from 2024-05-06T09:00 to 2024-05-10T18:00 JST. Reservation ID: LAB-APAC-0426-01. Reply with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

maria-partnerships: OK. Action items: (1) @liang-mlops run firmware probe and report compatibility by Apr 29. (2) @tom-hw-eng validate nvlink on B200 fallback by Apr 30. (3) @sam-ops confirm spare capacity and dry-run SLA by May 1. (4) @anita-sales draft joint-announce template and embargo window options by May 2.

liang-mlops: Starting probe now, will paste short logs if I hit checksum/firmware mismatches. If MI300 shows older microcode we may need a hotfix; ETA ~48h for staged rollout.

tom-hw-eng: Quick script I'll run: 
```
nvlink-check --nodes H20001,H20002 --firmware v2.4
```
If it fails we will try v2.3 across the bench and record regression. Will post results by EOD Apr 30.

anita-sales: Messaging constraints: cannot include hard SKU dates in release language. Suggest "available in select regions with partners" + partner quote. Legal needs loop-in before any public statement. I'll ping legal after we have test signoff.

sam-ops: Confirmed spare B200 bench in tokyo-2 for fallback. SLA for dry-run is best-effort unless converted to reserved capacity. Cost estimate for 5-day dry-run ~ $2.3k — attaching billing stub in thread.

maria-partnerships: Great. If all green by May 2, target a soft press hold for May 15 with partner (no public mention until legal/PR clear). If issues, push announcement to June. Please ack resource reservation and tasks. Thanks :thumbsup:

labbot: reminder: please ack resource reservations by reacting with :white_check_mark:.
